entities.summary: Nina Pinto-Abecasis was an Israeli folklorist, writer and educator. Her folklore research specialised in the Haketia language, a form of Judaeo-Spanish historically spoken by Sephardim in North Africa. She was also known for advocating for the inclusion of nicknames in folklore studies.
